# Feature: godot collect scenario

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-15 — issue #43 -->

## Intent
A Godot 2D fixture run records engine samples from the Godot Performance API (at least FPS or frame time) into a CON-001 run artifact. Temporary instrumentation is removed after the run or only written as a confirm-addon. A missing collector is `unsupported` so rules skip.

## Preconditions
- Godot detect/doctor (#42)
- Collector hub + scenario driver contracts
- Quick Scan writes schema-valid artifacts (#18)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Samples include at least FPS or frame-time from Godot Performance
- [ ] Run artifact stays CON-001 compatible
- [ ] Temporary instrumentation is removed after the run or treated as a confirm-addon
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Missing collector → unsupported; web CDP rules skip
- [ ] No Godot binary: fixture snapshot still collects; live binary stays optional
- [ ] Addon is not copied without confirm

## Regression
- [ ] Web-threejs doctor/run still require a browser
- [ ] Godot detect evidence unchanged
- [ ] Out: Web CDP collector

## Assumptions
- Live Godot `--quit-after` is not required in CI; the 2D fixture ships a recorded Performance snapshot
- UI copy is English
- Dashboard reuses existing run-detail/sample views

## Security Coverage
- P-04: addon writes stay under `addons/potato-boost/` inside the project root; `..` rejected
- Detect/collect are read-only except confirm-addon
- F-03: no tokens in localStorage
- Out of scope: F-01, B-01, Web CDP

## Implementation Notes
- Collector reads `potato.godot-performance.json` and maps `timeProcessS`/`fps` to `frame_time` ms (`godot.performance`).
- Missing snapshot is `unsupported` and not required; web CDP rules stay skipped.
- Doctor treats a valid snapshot as fixture mode: live binary is optional.
- Addon dump script writes only after confirm and stays under `addons/potato-boost/`.
- CLI `run`/`ci` attach the Godot collector and scenario driver when detect finds Godot; tests may still override Quick Scan deps.
- `git diff packages/core` stays empty.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: Godot fixture snapshot → collector samples → CON-001 artifact metrics; addon only after confirm.
- N-actors: one project → one snapshot read → one artifact; no fan-out.
- Invalid: missing snapshot → unsupported (rules skip); missing binary and snapshot → doctor blocks exit 3.
- Two consumers: CLI `run` and `ci` share `godotQuickScanDeps`; local-api doctor uses the same `runGodotDoctor`.
